Armed with field expertise and a determination to investigate the unknown, Forrest examines evidence, follows local accounts and ventures into extreme habitats in search of answers. Every expedition brings a new challenge, but could the next clue lead him to an animal thought to be extinct?
Watch Extinct Or Alive, Season 1, Episodes 1, 6 and 4; Season 2, Episodes 4, 8 and 10, on Animal Planet India.
